visual_review.method: every page compared side by side with the source at 55-60 dpi with 110-300 dpi close-ups; first-line baselines measured against the source on every page (median offset within 0.5 pt); figure crops on p6 and p13 corrected; check.py leaves 3 pre-existing measurement artefacts (p8 side text vs figure, p13/p16 wide math boxes) with no visible overlap
